title: Firm Commitments
eligible_reason: The paper is mainly a set of predictive panel regressions of future commitment indicators (F.cdpcommit, F.sbtcommit2, targets, abatement rates) on log scope 1 emissions and eleven time-varying firm characteristics with country, year and (industry or firm) fixed effects (Tables 2-11, 13). The only DiD is Table 12: reghdfe lnscope1tot i.treat##i.after + 11 time-varying firm controls, absorb(country year isin), cluster(id#year). Treated firms are those that newly commit to CDP (or SBTi) in a given year; control firms are the single size-nearest non-committing firm in the same GICS-6 industry-year (nearest-neighbour matching, commitments_final_full.do lines 1476-1488), and `after` is a window around the matched pair's commitment year (lines 1493-1520). This is a matching-based DiD with time-varying controls and a second treatment variant (SBTi), all excluded by PROTOCOL.md Section 2. Commitment years differ across firms, so timing is staggered, but no unit-and-time TWFE version without matching or controls is estimated. No data are provided (licensed CDP, Trucost, FactSet, IBES, Thomson Reuters, MSCI, Germanwatch).
design_notes: Firm-year panel of global listed firms (Trucost emissions universe), roughly 2005-2020. Table 12 Panel A: lnscope1tot on treat x after for CDP commitments (N = 13,278) and SBTi commitments (treat2 x after2, N = 3,357); also F3.lnscope1tot versions. Reported coefficients in table12b.txt: treat#after -0.153 (0.024), treat2#after2 -0.065 (0.033), F3 versions 0.049 (0.028) and 0.027 (0.061). Robust SEs clustered by firm-year. Also stated in readme as using Stata 15-18 with outreg2; results start at line 1042 of the do file.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Commitment years are firm specific (CDP commitments observed from 2011, SBTi from 2014/2015), but the cohort distribution cannot be computed without the data.

specs.exclusion_reason: nearest-neighbour matched control group (size within GICS-6 industry-year); 11 time-varying firm controls; event window defined around matched pair's commitment year
specs.treatment_definition: treat = 1 if cdpcommit switches from 0 to 1 (first commitment year), 0 for the size-matched same-industry-year control firm; after = 1 from the commitment year onward within a -4/+3 year window (lines 1476-1520)
specs.controls: lnsize lnppe wbooklev wroe wmb winvass beta_int wvolat wmom ret1 msci
specs.sample_condition: included2 != . (all controls non-missing); treat and after non-missing

specs.exclusion_reason: same matched design and controls for SBTi commitments
specs.treatment_definition: treat2 = first SBTi commitment year firm vs size-matched control; after2 analogous
specs.controls: lnsize lnppe wbooklev wroe wmb winvass beta_int wvolat wmom ret1 msci

data_files_note: Package contains commitments_final_full.do (1,829 lines incl. data construction from licensed sources), ms_readme_bk.docx, log.txt and outreg2 tables table3a-table13 (.txt/.xls). No data files.
priority_note: Not eligible: matched DiD with time-varying controls; no data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). The ft_staggered / Goodman-Bacon flags most likely come from a discussion of the Table 12 design rather than from an estimated staggered TWFE. Regression list data/packages/mnsc.2024.07298_regressions.txt (145 lines) confirms no other DiD commands.
